p8bDisclaimer: Cinematic risk-front visualization, not physical tsunami height.
notes: P8-B renders a cinematic risk-front light curtain from hazard-layer v1 official_spatial data. Tokyo Metropolitan Government tsunami Open Data 10m mesh is the primary source for Chuo and was clipped to the official MLIT N03 Chuo polygon. Official metropolitan source identified; spatial depth/boundary extracted: yes; current risk front driver: official_spatial. This is an official extracted spatial hazard layer, but it is not a full real-time fluid simulation and the stored boundary is a derived grid-extent bbox rather than an official inundation contour. maxTsunamiHeightMeters is separate from inundationDepthMeters and is not used as the inundation-depth grid. Arrival time, boundary, depth, intensity, confidence, sourceMode, extractionStatus, and evidenceSourceId drive the front. Kilometer-scale visualHeightMeters is cinematic-only and not physical tsunami height.
